sections.title: 🏆 The 60-second version
bullets: Each week you play one team. Whoever wins more of the 9 stat categories wins the week. 5-4 counts the same as 9-0.
Our build: big men. We win FG%, Rebounds, Blocks and Turnovers (fewer is better), plus Points or Steals. We ignore Free-Throw %.
Only 25 games count per week. Hold at 24, then start everyone on the busiest night. Every game that night counts.
Check the app for 5 minutes a day before 7 PM ET. You never need to watch a game.
Trade two good players for one great one. The deep waiver wire refills the empty spot.

sections.title: 💰 Draft night (auction, $200)
bullets: Plan A: Wembanyama ~$78 + Giannis ~$52 + one core big ~$30. Then values and $1 guards.
Plan B (Wemby above $80): Jokic ~$80 + Jalen Johnson + Amen Thompson + Duren + Clingan.
On your nomination turn early on, nominate from the Nominate list (expensive players we don't want) so rivals spend.
Never bid past MAX. Any bid can be the final one.
Lost a bidding war? Move that money to the next player in the same tier. Don't sit on it.
Get 3+ guard-eligible players (PG/SG) for the guard slots.
Room heat above ×1.08 = prices running hot, so wait for bargains. Below ×0.95 = buy now.
Finish with $0-3 left. Leftover money is worthless after the draft.
Tap each sale into the Draft tab so Budget, Max bid and Room heat stay right.

sections.title: 🧮 The 25-game trick
bullets: ESPN counts at most 25 starter games per week, checked at the START of each day.
If you start a day at 24 games, every game that day counts, even 30+.
Each Monday the My Team tab picks your ALL-IN night (the most of your players playing).
Before that night, start only as many players as the plan says (start your best ones).
Enter ESPN's Games Played number in My Team each morning to keep the plan accurate.
Ahead in FG% near the limit? Don't start poor shooters. Behind? Start efficient big men first.

sections.title: 📅 Daily 5-minute routine (before 7 PM ET)
bullets: Open Injuries → My players. Anyone 'Out'? Move him to IR in ESPN and start someone else.
Anyone 'Day-To-Day'? Check again about 1 hour before his game.
Open My Team: how many to start today? Set it in the ESPN app.
Every starting slot should have a player with a game, except when holding at 24.
Late West Coast games (10 PM ET): put those players in UTIL/G/F slots so you can swap if they sit.

sections.title: 🗓 Monday plan (20-30 minutes)
bullets: Look at this week's opponent in ESPN. Which of our 5 categories could he beat us in?
Today tab: which day has the most NBA games? Usually that's the ALL-IN night.
Plan 1-2 pickups: a fill-in for the ALL-IN night or a blocks/steals specialist.
Thursday/Friday: ignore categories already won or lost; spend moves only on close ones.

sections.title: 🔁 Waivers, IR and pickups
bullets: Watch minutes, not one big game. A player suddenly playing 30+ minutes is worth adding.
Our waiver priority never resets. Only use it when a starter gets hurt and his backup takes over.
Max 7 pickups per week. Keep one for the last day.
IR (2 spots): only players marked Out/IR can go there. When an IR player is healthy again, ESPN blocks all pickups until you move him back.
Never drop a good player for a one-week rental.

sections.title: 🤝 Trades
bullets: Two good players for one great one = the best trade under the 25-game limit.
Sell players whose value is free throws, assists or 3-pointers (categories we ignore).
Buy injured or slumping big men cheap.
Only 2 managers need to veto, so trades must LOOK fair. Explain why in the note.
Trade deadline: Feb 19, 2027, noon ET.

sections.title: 🏁 Playoffs (≈ mid-March to early April 2027)
bullets: 6 of 10 teams make it. A top-2 finish probably earns a first-round bye.
Ties in the standings are broken by head-to-head record, so beat the other top teams.
Dallas and Phoenix play the most games in the playoff weeks; Cleveland and New Orleans the fewest.
Late season, bad teams rest stars. Sell their stars before Feb 19; pick up their young players.

sections.title: 📖 Words you'll hear
bullets: FG% / FT%: field-goal % / free-throw %. 3PM: 3-pointers made. TO: turnovers (fewer wins).
PG/SG = guards, SF/PF = forwards, C = center. G slot = any guard, F = any forward, UTIL = anyone.
Punt: ignore a category on purpose to win the others.
Out / Day-To-Day (DTD) / Game-Time Decision (GTD): injury tags.
Back-to-back: a team playing two nights in a row. Stars often rest one.
ADP: how early players usually get drafted. Sleeper = underrated, bust = overrated.
